# Project Euler

> > A mathematical programming platform featuring computational problems that require both mathematical insight and programming skills to solve.

Project Euler is a learning platform dedicated to challenging problems at the intersection of mathematics and computer science. Users solve progressively difficult problems using their programming language of choice, developing problem-solving skills in number theory, combinatorics, and algorithmic thinking.

## Key Topics

- Mathematical programming
- Problem solving
- Computational mathematics
- Number theory
- Algorithm design
- Euler problems
- Programming challenges
- Competitive programming
- Mathematical proofs
- Combinatorics
- Learning platform
- Code optimization
